years_of_experience.question: R-173: fifteen or sixteen years?
years_of_experience.method: Earliest dated role start on the CV of record, measured to the contract's as-at date.
years_of_experience.day_assumption: The CV states month-and-year only. 2010-05-01 is used as the start instant; this is the assumption, not an observed value. Using 2010-05-31 instead yields 16.26 years, which still rounds to 16 whole years.
years_of_experience.resolution: Sixteen. The CV's own dated employment record places the earliest role start at May 2010, which is 16.3 years to 2026-09-03. The CV's prose says "15+ year", which is true but understated by a full year. Any site copy should say sixteen, or state the year ("since 2010") and let it compute. R-173 is settled in favour of sixteen.
years_of_experience.computation_command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
from datetime import date
s=date(2010,5,1); e=date(2026,9,3)
d=(e-s).days
print(d, d/365.25)
EOF

observed_anomalies.description: The two ANZ entries overlap in time. "Senior Delivery Lead / Technical Product Owner" is dated Sept 2017 - June 2025 (page 2) while "AI/ML Strategy & Solutions Architect" at the same employer is dated 2017 - 2022 (page 2). The CV does not state whether these were concurrent titles, a promotion sequence printed out of order, or a layout artefact.
observed_anomalies.impact: None on the years-of-experience computation: both fall inside the continuous May 2010 - present span. Any site timeline rendering ANZ as a single tenure should use Sept 2017 - June 2025 and treat the Architect entry as a nested title.

observed_anomalies.description: "Independent AI Consulting & Upskilling" (June 2025 - Feb 2026) is printed last on page 3, after MYOB (May 2010 - Aug 2011), breaking the otherwise reverse-chronological order. It is chronologically the second-most-recent role.
observed_anomalies.impact: A timeline built by reading the PDF top-to-bottom would place a 2025-2026 role before a 2010 role. Sort by parsed start date, not print order.

self_verification.method: Every extracted string (employer, title, date text, location, each bullet, each education field, each certification name, each skills block, each metric value and its context, the career objective, and each contact value) was re-checked as a substring of a fresh pdftotext run of the page it claims, using column crops (-x/-W) to defeat the two-column interleave and a soft-hyphen rejoin rule for words broken across a line.
self_verification.soft_hyphen_rule: regex ([A-Za-z])- ([a-z]) -> \1-\2, applied only to the PDF side of the comparison, to rejoin words the layout split across lines (e.g. "test-\nevidence" -> "test-evidence", "re-\nbaselining" -> "re-baselining").
